w: Sector Los Angeles, Submerged Land Act (SLA)
d: Aqueous will conduct a deep-water mooring overhaul at Platforms Hondo and Harmony using the derrick/construction barge SALTA VERDE, official number 622241, call sign WDF 9705, and tug SARAH C. Operations are expected to occur on or about November 15 through November 30, 2026, on a 12-hour-per-day basis. The project area is located at Platform Hondo, approximately 34.376216, -120.165145, and Platform Harmony, approximately 34.388549, -120.132726. SALTA VERDE is a 185-foot by 50-foot derrick/construction barge with a black hull and a large deck-mounted crane. The vessel will monitor VHF-FM Channel 16 and cellular telephone (805) 570-2642. All mariners are advised to transit the area with caution.
